Attach self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates.
Attach certificates from the employer/head of office/forwarding authority, vigilance clearance and certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCCT Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I) completely. Attach self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates. Attach certificates from the employer/head of office/forwarding authority, vigilance clearance and certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years. Send to the Secretary, National Council for Cooperative Training, 3 Siri Institutional Area, August Kranti Marg, HauzKhas, New Delhi-110 016. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCCT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NCCT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Registrar.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NCCT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I in the notice (separate forms for deputation and direct recruitment)) and send it to Secretary, National Council for Cooperative Training, 3 Siri Institutional Area, August Kranti Marg, HauzKhas, New Delhi-110 016, by proper channel, to reach by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 50 years for Direct Recruitment / Not exceeding 56 years for deputation (as on last date of the receipt of the application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation: officials in the relevant field holding an analogous post on regular basis, or Post-Graduation with minimum 55% marks in any discipline, plus 12 years' administration experience in supervisory capacity (5 years in PML-11). Direct recruitment: Masters/Post Graduation in Cooperative Management/Cooperative Development/Cooperation/Human Resource Management with minimum 55% marks, plus 12 years' experience.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. For private sector/university candidates, CTC should be comparable with the prescribed pay scale. Selected candidate must serve at VAMNICOM, Pune.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Departmental candidates in the feeder cadre and in the direct line of promotion (on deputation).

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Interview of shortlisted candidates. Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for interview. Council may restrict the number of candidates on qualifications/experience higher than the minimum or other criteria.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Period of appointment initially three years, governed by DoPT terms and conditions as amended from time to time. All appointments provisional subject to verification of documents.
